oe_v49_wdr_act_charter_fund = {
	icon = extraordinary_taxes
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { country_type = pop }
			NOT = { country_type = building }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 240
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v49_wdr_mod_imperial_fund }
		}
	}
	cooldown = {
		type = oe_v49_wdr_act_charter_fund_cd
		years = 8
	}
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = {
			situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = {
				add_to_list = source
			}
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -240
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_wdr_mod_imperial_fund years = 10 mode = replace }
			add_prestige = 4
			oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			oe_v49_wdr_advance_progress_small_effect = yes
			oe_v49_wdr_sync_global_counts_effect = yes
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_v49_wdr_act_charter_fund_tt
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 480 } } add = 14 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 320 } } add = -12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { at_war = no } } add = 6 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { oe_v49_wdr_owns_any_megaproject = yes } } add = 8 }
	}
}
